revision_note: P3.3.2a revision: per-query per-time visibility in the model (spec 4.5), strict deterministic algorithms with mem-efficient/flash SDPA disabled for M2, optimizer-state restore without storage aliasing, source-stratified overlay plots. Budgets and gate thresholds unchanged.
note: P3.3.2 smoke budgets only; frozen training hyperparameters live in ar_scene_v1.json and are never overridden here

resume_gate.semantics: gate = (1) the FIRST post-resume loss bitwise equal to the uninterrupted run: one forward pass from restored weights over the restored batch with the restored dropout RNG, so any wrong checkpoint content (weights, Adam moments, loader position, RNG) diverges at this index; (2) losses over the compare_window within window_max_fraction_of_window_mean x window mean -- a safety net against sub-ULP effects that strict determinism might still allow (e.g. allocator-dependent kernel selection) while any state error diverges macroscopically within the first updates; (3) sample stream identical to the checkpoint snapshot; (4) resumed branch finite and still improving (mean of last progress_window losses < progress_factor x window mean). Long-horizon drift is recorded as diagnostic only, never gated. P3.3.2a determinism basis: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=False) with the mem-efficient and flash SDPA backends disabled (the first M2 run log showed the bf16 mem-efficient attention backward is nondeterministic under warn_only=True); the earlier allocator-layout-to-GEMM-selection attribution was withdrawn after the probe was found aliased (optimizer load_state_dict shares tensor storage with the payload; see runs/20260913_p332_model_smoke/CODEX_REVIEW.md). Optimizer state is restored without storage aliasing (restore_optimizer_isolated). Snapshot immutability of checkpoint_payload and payload independence after replica training are locked by tests/test_p33_train_checkpoint.py.
